This creates a debugfs directory for each HV guest (assuming debugfs
is enabled in the kernel config)
by which the contents of the guest's HPT (hashed page table) can be
read.  The directory is named vmnnnn
column2: where nnnn is the PID of the

column1: process that created the guest.  The file is named ""htab"".  This is
intended to help in debugging problems in the host's management
of guest memory.
The contents of the file consist of a series of lines like this:
The first field is the index of the entry in the HPT
third are the HPT entry
column2: so the third entry contains the real page

column1: number that is mapped by the entry if the entry's valid bit is set.
The fourth field is the guest's view of the second doubleword of the
entry
column2: so it contains the guest physical address.  (The format of the

column1: second through fourth fields are described in the Power ISA and also
in arch/powerpc/include/asm/mmu-hash64.h.)
